question: Is the substance 'petroleum' (per Act s.2)?
Flash point < 23 C?
23 C <= flash point < 65 C?
65 C <= flash point < 93 C?
Total Class B at one place <= 2,500 L AND no receptacle > 1,000 L?
if_false: LICENCE: form/authority per PESO SOP (XIII by District Authority if <=25,000 L non-bulk; else PESO) -> P6

question: Total Class C at one place <= 45,000 L (stored per rules)?
Class A quantity within SOP small-quantity exemption (<=30 L)?
if_false: LICENCE per SOP (XII by DA if <=300 L non-bulk; else PESO) -> P6
outcome_or_note: Import of Class A always needs licence (s.3(2))

question: Does the licence form require District Authority NOC (Rule 144)?
Cylinders possessed only by carrier for transport per rules?
Own use and not for sale/trading?
For each gas group (F-GAS-03): flammable non-toxic <=25 cyl & <=200 kg; non-flammable non-toxic <=200 cyl; toxic <=5 cyl; dissolved acetylene <=25 cyl?
outcome_or_note: Gas group never inferred (UNK-039); LPG see r.44(c)

question: Any vessel storing compressed gas with water capacity > 1,000 L?
if_false: EXIT: SMPV not engaged (GCR may apply)

question: Is the vessel in the r.2 exclusion list (reactor, heat exchanger, evaporator, air receiver, autoclave, steam vessel...) or part of a processing plant (r.3)?
Gas is non-toxic non-flammable?
if_true: LICENCE r.45 (no DA NOC needed, r.47(1))
if_false: Prior approval of plans -> DA NOC (r.47) -> LICENCE r.45 (LS-1A per SOP)

question: Does the unit manufacture any explosive?
if_true: LICENCE required (Explosives Rules 2008) even for small quantity

question: Possession/use of explosives?
if_true: Licence form per quantity (AE-2/AE-3...) - thresholds not extracted -> REQUIRES_OFFICIAL_CONFIRMATION

question: Any chemical meeting Sch 1 Part I criteria or listed in Sch 1 Part II / Sch 2 / Sch 3?
if_true: M1 (r.4 general duty applies to industrial activity)

question: Is the operation in a Sch 4 installation (industrial activity) or isolated storage or pipeline?
outcome_or_note: Organic synthesis processes (alkylation...mixing) are listed in Sch 4 item 1

question: Aggregated qty (R-061) >= col 3 of Sch 3 (industrial activity) / Sch 2 (isolated storage)?
if_true: MAH (r.2(ja)); r.7-9, 13-15 apply: approval + Sch 7 report >=3 months before; on-site plan; M3
if_false: r.4 & r.5 only (industrial activity); isolated storage below Sch 2 col 3 not covered by r.4(1)(b)

question: Aggregated qty >= col 4?
if_true: Safety report >=90 days before (r.10), annual audit, 3-yearly update (r.11)

question: Authority?
if_true: Sch 5: CIF (factories); SPCB (isolated storage not under factory law); CCE (PESO-licensed); District Collector (off-site plan)
